## Setup

```{r}
cats <- c(
  "Toxicity", "IdentityAttack", "Bias", "Microaggression",
  "Violence", "SelfHarm", "Insult", "SexualContent"
)

condition_levels <- c("control", "speech", "security")
language_levels  <- c("cn", "en")
model_levels     <- c("llama", "qwen")
```

## Prediction files: import and checks

```{r}
pred_files <- list.files(
  path = ".",
  pattern = "^classification_results_v[123]_(cn|en)_(llama|qwen)\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(pred_files) == 0) {
  stop("No prediction files found. Check working directory and file names.")
}

file_info <- str_match(
  basename(pred_files),
  "^classification_results_(v[123])_(cn|en)_(llama|qwen)\\.csv$"
)

file_manifest <- tibble(
  file = pred_files,
  filename = basename(pred_files),
  version = file_info[, 2],
  language = file_info[, 3],
  model = file_info[, 4]
) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = recode(
      version,
      v1 = "control",
      v2 = "speech",
      v3 = "security"
    ),
    language = factor(language, levels = language_levels),
    model = factor(model, levels = model_levels),
    condition = factor(condition, levels = condition_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(language, model, condition)

file_manifest
```

```{r}
required_prediction_files <- expand_grid(
  language = factor(language_levels, levels = language_levels),
  model = factor(model_levels, levels = model_levels),
  condition = factor(condition_levels, levels = condition_levels)
)

missing_prediction_files <- required_prediction_files %>%
  anti_join(
    file_manifest %>% select(language, model, condition),
    by = c("language", "model", "condition")
  )

if (nrow(missing_prediction_files) > 0) {
  print(missing_prediction_files)
  stop("Some prediction files are missing.")
}
```

```{r}
required_cols <- c("id", "input_text", "raw_text", cats)

file_manifest <- file_manifest %>%
  mutate(
    data = map(file, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE)),
    missing_cols = map(data, ~ setdiff(required_cols, names(.x)))
  )

bad_col_files <- file_manifest %>%
  filter(map_int(missing_cols, length) > 0)

if (nrow(bad_col_files) > 0) {
  print(bad_col_files %>% select(filename, missing_cols))
  stop("Some prediction files are missing required columns.")
}
```

```{r}
desc_stats
write_csv(desc_stats, "desc_stats_by_language_model_condition_category.csv")
```

```{r}
wide_scores <- prediction_long %>%
  select(language, model, id, category, condition, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = condition,
    values_from = score
  )
```

```{r}
safe_paired_wilcox <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x <- x[ok]
  y <- y[ok]

  if (length(x) == 0) {
    return(list(W = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
  }

  if (all(x == y)) {
    return(list(W = NA_real_, p = 1))
  }

  wt <- suppressWarnings(
    wilcox.test(x, y, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
  )

  list(W = unname(wt$statistic), p = wt$p.value)
}
```

```{r}
run_paired_wilcox <- function(wide_df, a, b) {
  wide_df %>%
    group_by(language, model, category) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      x <- .x[[a]]
      y <- .x[[b]]
      wt <- safe_paired_wilcox(x, y)

      tibble(
        n = sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
        mean_a = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_b = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_diff = mean(y - x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_diff = median(y - x, na.rm = TRUE),
        changed = sum((y != x) & !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
        up = sum((y > x) & !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
        down = sum((y < x) & !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
        W = wt$W,
        p = wt$p
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(comparison = paste0(b, "_vs_", a)) %>%
    group_by(language, model, comparison) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    relocate(language, model, comparison, category)
}
```

```{r}
comp_speech_vs_control   <- run_paired_wilcox(wide_scores, "control", "speech")
comp_security_vs_control <- run_paired_wilcox(wide_scores, "control", "security")
comp_security_vs_speech  <- run_paired_wilcox(wide_scores, "speech", "security")

pairwise_results <- bind_rows(
  comp_speech_vs_control,
  comp_security_vs_control,
  comp_security_vs_speech
)

paper_table <- pairwise_results %>%
  mutate(
    mean_a = round(mean_a, 3),
    mean_b = round(mean_b, 3),
    mean_diff = round(mean_diff, 3),
    median_diff = round(median_diff, 3),
    p = signif(p, 3),
    p_adj_bh = signif(p_adj_bh, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(
    language, model, comparison, category, n,
    mean_a, mean_b, mean_diff, median_diff,
    changed, up, down, W, p, p_adj_bh
  )

paper_table
write_csv(paper_table, "pairwise_wilcox_results_by_language_model.csv")
```

```{r}
diff_summary <- pairwise_results %>%
```

```{r}
make_diff_plot <- function(df, lang, mdl, panel_label, x_limits = NULL) {
  p <- df %>%
    filter(language == lang, model == mdl) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = mean_diff, y = category, fill = comparison)) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.72),
      width = 0.62
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.6,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Mean difference in score",
      y = NULL,
      fill = NULL,
      caption = panel_label
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, byrow = TRUE)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.direction = "horizontal",
      legend.justification = "center",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        family = "serif",
        face = "bold",
        size = 13,
        margin = margin(t = 10)
      ),
      plot.caption.position = "plot",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 8, 8, 8)
    )

  if (!is.null(x_limits)) {
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = x_limits)
  }

  p
}

# 如果你想更像示例图，可以给 Llama 和 Qwen 用不同的 x 轴范围
x_llama <- c(-0.15, 0.35)
x_qwen  <- c(-0.15, 0.22)

main_diff_plot_cn_llama <- make_diff_plot(
  diff_summary, "cn", "llama",
  "(a) Chinese, Llama",
  x_limits = x_llama
)

main_diff_plot_cn_qwen <- make_diff_plot(
  diff_summary, "cn", "qwen",
  "(b) Chinese, Qwen",
  x_limits = x_qwen
)

main_diff_plot_en_llama <- make_diff_plot(
  diff_summary, "en", "llama",
  "(c) English, Llama",
  x_limits = x_llama
)

main_diff_plot_en_qwen <- make_diff_plot(
  diff_summary, "en", "qwen",
  "(d) English, Qwen",
  x_limits = x_qwen
)

main_diff_plot_combined <-
  (main_diff_plot_cn_llama | main_diff_plot_cn_qwen) /
  (main_diff_plot_en_llama | main_diff_plot_en_qwen) +
  plot_annotation(
    theme = theme(
      plot.caption = element_text(
        hjust = 0,
        family = "serif",
        size = 14,
        face = "bold",
        margin = margin(t = 12)
      )
    )
  )

main_diff_plot_combined

ggsave(
```

## Gold files and matched subset

```{r}
gold_candidates <- tribble(
  ~language, ~candidate,
  "cn", "RTP_LX_ZH_Hans_prompt_gold.csv",
  "cn", "RTP_LX_ZH_Hans_gold.csv",
  "cn", "RTP_LX_ZH_prompt_gold.csv",
  "en", "RTP_LX_EN_prompt_gold.csv",
  "en", "RTP_LX_English_prompt_gold.csv",
  "en", "RTP_LX_EN_gold.csv"
)

gold_manifest <- gold_candidates %>%
  mutate(exists = file.exists(candidate)) %>%
  group_by(language) %>%
  filter(exists) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(file = candidate)

missing_gold_lang <- tibble(language = language_levels) %>%
  anti_join(gold_manifest %>% select(language), by = "language")

if (nrow(missing_gold_lang) > 0) {
  print(missing_gold_lang)
  stop("Gold file missing for at least one language.")
}
```

```{r}
standardize_gold <- function(df) {
  if ("gold_input_text" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename(input_text = gold_input_text)
  }

  if ("gold_id" %in% names(df) && !"id" %in% names(df)) {
    df <- df %>% rename(id = gold_id)
  }

  for (nm in cats) {
    if (nm %in% names(df) && !paste0("gold_", nm) %in% names(df)) {
      df <- df %>% rename(!!paste0("gold_", nm) := all_of(nm))
    }
  }

  df
}
```

```{r}
gold_all <- gold_manifest %>%
  mutate(
    data = map2(
      file, language,
      ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        standardize_gold() %>%
        mutate(language = .y)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(data) %>%
  unnest(data)

gold_all
```

```{r}
gold_long_ref <- gold_all %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(paste0("gold_", cats)),
    names_to = "gold_category",
    values_to = "gold_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(category = str_remove(gold_category, "^gold_")) %>%
  select(language, id, input_text, category, gold_score)
```

```{r}
gold_joined <- prediction_full %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(cats),
    names_to = "category",
    values_to = "pred_score"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    gold_long_ref,
    by = c("language", "id", "category"),
    suffix = c("_pred", "_gold")
  ) %>%
  rename(
    pred_input_text = input_text_pred,
    gold_input_text = input_text_gold
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = factor(category, levels = cats),
    error = pred_score - gold_score,
    abs_error = abs(error),
    exact_match = pred_score == gold_score
  )
```

## Gold-based agreement analyses

```{r}
human_alignment_summary <- gold_matched %>%
  group_by(language, model, condition, category) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    pred_mean = mean(pred_score),
    gold_mean = mean(gold_score),
    signed_error = mean(error),
    mae = mean(abs_error),
    exact_match_prop = mean(exact_match),
    over_rate_prop = mean(error > 0),
    under_rate_prop = mean(error < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

human_alignment_summary
write_csv(human_alignment_summary, "human_alignment_summary_by_language_model.csv")
```

```{r}
calc_kappa <- function(df) {
  tmp <- df %>%
    select(pred_score, gold_score) %>%
    drop_na()

  if (nrow(tmp) < 2) return(NA_real_)

  irr::kappa2(tmp, weight = "squared")$value
}

kappa_results <- gold_matched %>%
  group_by(language, model, condition, category) %>%
  group_modify(~ tibble(weighted_kappa = calc_kappa(.x))) %>%
  ungroup()

kappa_results
write_csv(kappa_results, "weighted_kappa_results_by_language_model.csv")
```

```{r}
alignment_table <- human_alignment_summary %>%
  left_join(
    kappa_results,
    by = c("language", "model", "condition", "category")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pred_mean = round(pred_mean, 3),
    gold_mean = round(gold_mean, 3),
    signed_error = round(signed_error, 3),
    mae = round(mae, 3),
    exact_match_prop = round(exact_match_prop, 3),
    over_rate_prop = round(over_rate_prop, 3),
    under_rate_prop = round(under_rate_prop, 3),
    weighted_kappa = round(weighted_kappa, 3)
  )

alignment_table
write_csv(alignment_table, "alignment_table_for_paper_by_language_model.csv")
```

```{r}
tox_gold <- gold_matched %>%
  filter(category == "Toxicity") %>%
  mutate(
    gold_remove = if_else(gold_score >= 4, 1, 0),
    pred_remove = if_else(pred_score >= 4, 1, 0)
  )

remove_error_summary <- tox_gold %>%
  group_by(language, model, condition) %>%
  summarise(
    TP = sum(pred_remove == 1 & gold_remove == 1),
    TN = sum(pred_remove == 0 & gold_remove == 0),
    FP = sum(pred_remove == 1 & gold_remove == 0),
    FN = sum(pred_remove == 0 & gold_remove == 1),
    FPR = FP / (FP + TN),
    FNR = FN / (FN + TP),
    accuracy = (TP + TN) / n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

remove_error_summary
write_csv(remove_error_summary, "remove_error_summary_vs_gold_by_language_model.csv")
```

## Cross-model comparison

### Prediction-only cross-model comparison

```{r}
wide_model_scores <- prediction_long %>%
  select(language, condition, id, category, model, score) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = model,
    values_from = score
  )
```

```{r}
run_model_wilcox <- function(wide_df, a = "llama", b = "qwen") {
  wide_df %>%
    group_by(language, condition, category) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      x <- .x[[a]]
      y <- .x[[b]]
      wt <- safe_paired_wilcox(x, y)

      tibble(
        n = sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
        mean_a = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_b = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_diff = mean(y - x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_diff = median(y - x, na.rm = TRUE),
        W = wt$W,
        p = wt$p
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(language, condition) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(comparison = "qwen_vs_llama") %>%
    relocate(language, condition, comparison, category)
}

model_comparison_results <- run_model_wilcox(wide_model_scores)

model_comparison_results
write_csv(model_comparison_results, "model_comparison_results_prediction_only.csv")
```

### Gold-based common-subset cross-model comparison

```{r}
wide_model_error <- gold_matched_common %>%
  select(language, condition, id, category, model, error, abs_error) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = model,
    values_from = c(error, abs_error)
  )
```

```{r}
run_model_metric_wilcox <- function(df, prefix) {
  df %>%
    group_by(language, condition, category) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      x <- .x[[paste0(prefix, "_llama")]]
      y <- .x[[paste0(prefix, "_qwen")]]
      wt <- safe_paired_wilcox(x, y)

      tibble(
        n = sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
        mean_llama = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_qwen = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_diff = mean(y - x, na.rm = TRUE),
        median_diff = median(y - x, na.rm = TRUE),
        W = wt$W,
        p = wt$p
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(language, condition) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(metric = prefix) %>%
    relocate(language, condition, metric, category)
}

model_error_comparison <- bind_rows(
  run_model_metric_wilcox(wide_model_error, "error"),
  run_model_metric_wilcox(wide_model_error, "abs_error")
)

model_error_comparison
write_csv(model_error_comparison, "model_error_comparison_common_gold_subset.csv")
```
